from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,socket,sys,tarfile,subprocess,time
from google.protobuf import text_format
p=Path('/home/dflanag3/src/spacial_desktop/spatial-os-luna-handoff');assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0]=='sb16-2'
os.umask(0o077);sys.path[:0]=[str(p/'tests/core'),str(p/'build/python'),str(p)]
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],str(p/'build/identityd'),str(p/'build/spatial-issuer-client'),str(p/'build/spatial-issuer-watch')]
from test_identity_watch import WatchProcess
from test_identity_enrollment import EnrollmentFixture
import issuer_pb2 as pb
fixture=EnrollmentFixture();fixture.setUp()
bundle=p/'local/m01-watch-crosshost-fixture.tar';folder=p/'local/m01-watch-crosshost';folder.mkdir()
try:
 with tarfile.open(bundle) as archive:
  members=archive.getmembers()
  assert {m.name for m in members}=={'connection.json','server.crt','service.crt','service.pem'}
  for m in members:
   assert m.isfile() and m.size<65536
   (fixture.root/m.name).write_bytes(archive.extractfile(m).read())
 metadata=json.loads((fixture.root/'connection.json').read_text());assert metadata['host']=='sb16'
 config=pb.IssuerTlsClientConfig(protocol_version=1,address=socket.gethostbyname('sb16'),port=metadata['port'],
  server_name='issuer.test',server_ca_path=str(fixture.root/'server.crt'),certificate_path=str(fixture.root/'service.crt'),
  private_key_path=str(fixture.root/'service.pem'),issuer_id=bytes.fromhex(metadata['issuer_id']),
  issuer_public_key=bytes.fromhex(metadata['issuer_public_key']),io_timeout_ms=3000)
 path=fixture.root/'client.textproto';path.write_text(text_format.MessageToString(config))
 watcher=WatchProcess(path,fixture.root/'watch.log');fixture.addCleanup(watcher.close)
 initial=watcher.receive();assert initial.protocol_version==1 and initial.batch.initial and initial.batch.head_revision==0
 print('WATCH_READY',flush=True)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+60
 while not (folder/'release').exists():
  assert watcher.proc.poll() is None
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Cross-host coordinator expired')
  time.sleep(.05)
 update=watcher.receive()
 assert update.protocol_version==1 and update.batch.issuer_id==config.issuer_id and update.batch.through_revision==1
 assert len(update.batch.events)==1 and update.batch.events[0].target.kind==pb.CREDENTIAL_TARGET
 assert update.batch.events[0].target.id.hex()==metadata['credential_id']
 watcher.close();assert watcher.proc.returncode==0
 record={'status':'passed','client_host':'sb16-2','server_host':'sb16','client_program':'spatial-issuer-watch',
  'checks':['production client server trust and name verification','mutual TLS','pinned issuer identity',
            'checked initial baseline','ordered committed remote revocation','clean supervisor shutdown'],
  'client_binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'build/spatial-issuer-watch').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  'test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'tests/core/test_identity_watch.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 (folder/'client.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
finally:
 fixture.doCleanups();bundle.unlink(missing_ok=True)

checks: production client server trust and name verification

fixture_cleanup: Temporary keys, certificates, issuer database, and transfer archives removed.

coordinator.transport: scp -3 relayed the disposable service bundle through the Windows SSH client with normal host verification.
coordinator.trigger: After WATCH_READY, the coordinator created the server revoke marker and the client release marker through their existing SSH connections.
setup_attempts: The first fixture was stopped before testing to reconnect its management peer only when revocation was requested.
The second setup transfer failed because sb16-2 did not trust the sb16 SSH host key. It was stopped before notification testing. The coordinator then used its existing verified SSH connections.
